checks.title: App Service plans without an autoscale setting

waf.why: Capacity choices are part of the performance targets.

collector.violations: resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.web/serverfarms' | extend planKey=tolower(id) | join kind=leftanti (resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/autoscalesettings' | extend planKey=tolower(tostring(properties.targetResourceUri)) | project planKey) on planKey | project id, name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, skuName=tostring(sku.name)

checks.proves: No autoscale setting targets the App Service plan.
checks.doesNotProve: Whether the plan needs to scale, or whether scaling is done another way (manual, schedule in another resource).

checks.title: Advisor performance recommendations

waf.why: Advisor performance recommendations point at capacity and configuration choices.

collector.evaluated: advisorresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | where tostring(properties.category) =~ 'Performance' | summarize n=count()
collector.violations: advisorresources | where type =~ 'microsoft.advisor/recommendations' | where tostring(properties.category) =~ 'Performance' | project id, subscriptionId, impact=tostring(properties.impact), problem=tostring(properties.shortDescription.problem)

checks.proves: Azure Advisor lists a recommendation in the Performance category for the resource.
checks.doesNotProve: That the workload is slow, or that the recommendation fits it.

checks.title: Performance targets and load tests

waf.why: Performance targets are a design practice.

text.en: Are performance targets defined for each workload, and has a load test been run against them?
text.pt-BR: As metas de desempenho estão definidas para cada carga de trabalho, e um teste de carga foi executado contra elas?

checks.proves: The answer of the person who knows the practice.
checks.doesNotProve: Whether the targets are met; no API shows it.
